key_insight: CausalForge combines Lean-based formal verification with an autonomous research pipeline to make automated theoretical causal inference more reliable than LLM-only review loops.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical blueprint for building agentic AI research systems where theorem generation, proof checking, and claim auditing are integrated into a single trustworthy workflow.
method: Causalean: a Lean causal-inference library with 7,035 machine-checked declarations
CausalSmith: an agentic pipeline that picks topics, proposes results, formalizes statements, and constructs proofs
Statement audit: checks whether the formal theorem actually matches the intended informal claim
evidence_signal: Evaluation is based on artifacts from completed autonomous research runs, with the authors emphasizing that Lean kernel verification is supplemented by claim-level auditing.
watch_item: A machine-checked proof can still formalize the wrong scientific claim, so correctness depends on the quality of the statement audit and human review.
paper_title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
